title: ‘These attacks must cease immediately’: Guterres condemns deadly Houthi strike on Riyadh airport
keyFacts: UN Secretary-General António Guterres has condemned a Houthi missile attack on Riyadh’s main airport that Saudi authorities say killed 12 people and wounded more than 300.

title: Giving a dam: Cultivating peace in Côte d’Ivoire
keyFacts: Adam Ouattara and Makongo Traoré have four children and a home on the edge of Torla village in Côte d’Ivoire. He herds cattle. She grows vegetables on a small plot nearby. For years, the dry season pitted their two livelihoods against each other.

title: India: UN rights office urges release of ‘arbitrarily detained’ protesters
keyFacts: The UN human rights office (OHCHR) has voiced concern over reports of mass detentions in India of demonstrators, protest leaders, civil society members, lawyers and journalists, before and during large-scale protests in Delhi on Saturday.

title: In the Mekong Delta, a push to grow food with saltwater

title: UN chief ‘gravely concerned’ by renewed fighting in northern Ethiopia, warns against escalation
keyFacts: UN Secretary-General António Guterres has called for an immediate end to the renewed fighting in northern Ethiopia, saying he is deeply worried by reports that Eritrean forces are present in the country.
